packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Agent-engine package
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Marks the agent-engine code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Automation package
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Marks the engine's automation code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Start background work
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Starts a ticket as background work for an agent.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Routine tick
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Fires the scheduled routines that are due.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Wake an agent
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Starts a new run to wake an agent.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Wake from a webhook
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Wakes an agent in one of the owner's conversations when a signed outside message arrives.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Cancellation checkpoint
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Checks at safe points whether a run has been cancelled.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Collaboration package
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Marks the engine's collaboration code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Create a team agent
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Creates a persistent team agent from a spec, with its standing instructions, and cleans up its links when it is deleted.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Group targets
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Works out which agents in a group a message is meant for.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Mentions
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Finds which agents are mentioned in a message.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Return helpers' outcomes
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Collects the results of background helper work and reports them back into the conversation that asked for it.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Who replies
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Decides which agents reply in a group: the mentioned ones, or the lead when none are mentioned.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Delegate to a peer
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Hands a piece of work to another agent.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Helper runs
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Spawns and inspects a temporary helper run of an agent.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Context engine
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Keeps each request to the AI model within the model's limits by summarizing and trimming older conversation while keeping the real messages intact.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Context package
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Marks the context-building code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Known account symbols
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds what earlier reads learned about an account's symbols to the agent's context.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Attachment context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Prepares the text and images of a message's attachments for the agent to read, within size limits.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Context builder
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Assembles everything an agent reads before it thinks: memory, history, permissions, the account picture and more.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Command context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Reads the slash-command an owner message carries and tells the agent what it asks for.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: History summarizing
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Summarizes older conversation so it still fits, without changing what actually happened.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Past-decisions context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds a short pointer to real past decisions, not the whole market history.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Operational context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds a bounded summary of what the agent's tools have recently observed.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Guard money claims
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Stops an agent claiming a trade or money action succeeded unless the server has independent proof.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Shared context limits
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Shares the common context-size limits used across the agent and routing.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Group context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds a group's details to an agent's context.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: History context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds past messages to the agent's context, labelling other agents' messages and card data as information, never as the owner's orders.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Image context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Prepares the images a tool returned for one model request, within size limits.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Memory context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds the owner's preferences and the agent's own memory and notes to its context.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Permission context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Tells the agent, every turn, what it is currently allowed to do, from verified state only.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Account picture
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Gives the agent, on every wake, an up-to-date picture of its accounts: positions, exposure, floating profit and upcoming high-impact events.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Reply context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds the message being replied to into the agent's context.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Wake context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Tells the agent what woke it — a scheduled routine, a workspace call or a signed outside message — as untrusted data.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Earlier-run evidence
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Carries bounded, timestamped evidence from the agent's earlier runs into this one.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Scratchpad context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds the agent's recent scratchpad notes to its context.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Skills context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Chooses which of the agent's skills are relevant and adds their instructions to its context.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Team context
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds the team and routing details to a lead agent's context.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Task continuation
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Lets a long task keep running in further bounded slices without resetting its original budget.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: End-of-turn check
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Decides whether an agent's reply really ends the owner's request, and records how a chosen option turned out.
